_description: Produced by: Phase 10 executor (updated after each model completes). Consumed by: Frontend progress UI (GET /api/experiments/{id}/status, polled every 2s), job scheduler.
_decisions: DECISION 2026-09-10: Status enum is guide-versions (CREATED..FAILED) — more granular than original contract, required by frontend StageProgress component.
DECISION 2026-09-10: Stage strings use guide-versions (classical_training, quantum_training) — match StageProgress.jsx STAGES keys.
DECISION 2026-09-10: circuit_executions field name chosen (not circuit_executions_so_far) — shorter, matches all guide code.
DECISION 2026-09-10: completed_models and current_model added — required by StageProgress.jsx to show ✓/●/○ per model.
DECISION 2026-09-10: progress_data JSON column in Experiment SQLite table stores current_model + completed_models + circuit_executions, updated by executor after each model.
FIX: Resolves ISSUES.md B-01 (status enum mismatch), M-01 (stage string mismatch), M-08 (no tracking mechanism), M-10 (undefined fields on MOCK_MODE=false).

experiment_id._description: Unique experiment identifier. Format: EXP-{8-char-hex} e.g. EXP-A1B2C3D4

status._description: Overall experiment lifecycle state. Transitions: CREATED → VALIDATING → PREPROCESSING → RUNNING_CLASSICAL → RUNNING_QUANTUM → BENCHMARKING → EXPLAINING → COMPLETED (or FAILED at any point).

stage._description: Current execution sub-stage. Used by StageProgress.jsx to show ✓/●/○ per pipeline step.

progress._description: Overall completion fraction. 0.0 = not started, 1.0 = completed.

message._description: Human-readable status string for UI display (e.g. progress bars, log panel).

elapsed_seconds._description: Seconds elapsed since started_at. Updated on every status write.

estimated_remaining_seconds._description: Estimated seconds remaining. Null until at least one model completes.

current_model._description: Name of the model currently training. Null when no model is actively training.

completed_models._description: Names of models that have finished (successfully or with error). Used by StageProgress.jsx ✓ markers.

circuit_executions._description: Running count of quantum circuit executions so far. Null for classical-only stages. Updated by executor after each batch during VQC training.

current_epoch._description: Current VQC training epoch. Null for classical models and non-training stages.

total_epochs._description: Total VQC training epochs configured. Null for classical models.

error_message._description: Error detail string when status=FAILED. Null otherwise. Displayed in red error box in frontend.

resource_snapshot._description: Point-in-time resource usage snapshot, sampled by ResourceMonitor.

_example_failed.message: VQC training failed: out of memory
_example_failed.error_message: MemoryError during quantum circuit simulation at epoch 11

_implementation_note: ExperimentManager must maintain a 'progress_data' JSON column in the Experiment SQLite table. ExperimentExecutor.run() calls manager.update_progress(experiment_id, {...}) after each model completes. The GET /api/experiments/{id}/status endpoint reads this column and returns it directly.
